sample: Uniform512 IDs from case1000 union selection, both legs; results conditional on per-leg cuts and both fits usable/successful. Same ID may appear in both legs.

selected_stress_examples.selection: 16 largest changes among the 1021-case/leg seeded-replay sample; deliberately selected stress examples, not a population estimate

interpretation: Negative T is explicitly permitted by original prior. This identifies large optimizer scatter, not a proof of mean calibration bias; no positivity cut or changed fitter was applied. The original success flag and disk-ellipticity usability do not exclude these solutions.
